name: TabStop2
description: Represents a single tab stop. The TabStop2 object is a member of the TabStops2 collection.
remarks: Tab stops are indexed numerically from left to right along the ruler.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the TabStop2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that represents the Microsoft Office application in which the TabStop2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets an Object that represents the Parent object for the TabStop2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Gets or sets the position of a tab stop relative to the left margin. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets or sets the type of the TabStop2 object. Read/write.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes the specified custom tab stop.
